name: @etzhayyim/pqh
description: AEAD envelope + Argon2id KDF + post-quantum hybrid (suite pqh-v1: X25519+ML-KEM-768, Ed25519+ML-DSA-65) + DID<->Signal identity binding + a deprecated toy Signal-session stand-in. Relocated from etzhayyim/root:20-actors/etzhayyim-sdk (src/{crypto,kdf,pq,did-signal,signal}.ts) per the kotoba-lang library-placement rule (ADR-2606302300). Zero etzhayyim-specific coupling -- generic crypto-agility seam. Named pqh (not crypto) to avoid colliding with kotoba-lang/crypto, an unrelated lower-level CLJC hash/HMAC/HKDF foundational-stdlib primitives repo.
